changes.action: existing current records get new versions with mapped values (PENDED->PENDING)
add column; existing current records get new versions with line_of_business = "COMMERCIAL" (declared backfill)
column and historical values retained; field no longer populated, validated or served
new batches use the new transform version; existing records keep the transform version that produced them

ddl: ALTER TABLE "t_northwind"."claim" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "line_of_business" text
rollback: Rollback is available until any batch is processed under the new version.
Records created by data operations (tagged _migration_id) are deleted and the versions they superseded become current again.
The previous contract version is re-activated; added columns are retained (nullable) and simply unused, so no data is dropped.
notes: Data operations never update rows in place: they write new record versions tagged with the migration id, so prior versions keep their original meaning and contract version.
